facts.quote: The great white pelican mainly eats fish.

facts.text: Loví společně ve skupinách po šesti až osmi, které tvoří podkovu.
facts.quote: A group of 6 to 8 great white pelicans gather in a horseshoe formation in water to feed together.
It needs from 0.9 to 1.4 kg (2.0 to 3.1 lb) of fish every day
In some situations, they eat chicks of other birds, such as the well documented case off the southwest coast of South Africa.

facts.text: Vejce a mláďata napadají například lišky, racci, vrány a orli.
facts.quote: Predators of the pelicans' eggs and chicks include mammalian animals like foxes, gulls, frigatebirds, crows, skuas, African fish eagles
